title: access.decision.recorded
description: The policy decision point recorded an authorization outcome. Every read and write decision is an event so that the access trail is reconstructable end to end (PSDD 8 Auditability) and so that CMMC / program-protection evidence can be generated automatically.

policyId.description: Identifier of the policy rule that produced the decision.

obligations.description: Downstream duties attached to an ALLOW, e.g. 'log-externally', 'watermark', 'no-export'.

context.description: Environmental factors considered by the policy (device posture, time, network zone).
